column1: # UniTime API surface, extracted from UniTime/unitime JavaSource.
# route = the @Service bean name, which is what ApiServlet.getBean() looks up.
# It is absolute inside the webapp context; the deployed URL is <context>+route.
# verbs = the do<Verb>(ApiHelper) overrides. A verb NOT listed is still a live
# crossing = verbs whose handler mutates state or delegates to another verb.
# guarded  = verbs that refuse at runtime unless application properties are set.
